purpose: Owner waiver and preserved review-lane record for DF-M0-008 and DF-M0-009; this record closes M0 planning but grants no production, dependency, legal, accessibility or release authority.

owner_decision.scope: The eight documented review lanes are not required to close M0 planning.

source_evidence.review_corrections_scope: Post-review clarification/corrections to FFI, performance, grid metadata, SSH/dependency provenance, distribution counts, GRDB provenance, SPDX PURLs, exact RustSec scanner binding, credential-lease cancellation ordering, SQLite file/backup/restore controls, dependency-policy commands, eight-role roadmap alignment and packet preflight; no production authority.

scope_sources.composition_note: The correction commit descends from the DF-M0-009 sibling through the packet baseline and contains corrected descendants of the pinned DF-M0-008 report/data lineage. It is neither byte-identical to nor represented as a Git merge of the pinned DF-M0-008 commit.

planning_preflight.claim_limit: Structural and traceability preflight only; ADR-0017 separately closes M0 planning by owner waiver, while no external acceptance or executable behavior is proven.

review_invariants: The eight lanes are waived for M0 rather than completed; the evidence author, an agent, a scanner, or a risk owner cannot fabricate a reviewer result.
Concur means the reviewer agrees with the current fail-closed or conditional record; it does not approve a production dependency, capability, implementation, release, license, or safety exception.
Any future changes_required or defer result records an owner and revisit trigger and cannot be converted into approval by the owner waiver.

Legal advice, private contact data, signatures, credentials, database data, and privileged analysis are not committed; only a non-privileged disposition summary and counsel-held reference may be recorded.

No review result can override a current advisory, missing exact identity, missing executable evidence, unsupported capability, database-safety invariant, or separate implementation-authorization gate.

closure_rules: ADR-0017 waives all three review lanes as an M0 exit prerequisite without supplying a result.
Every candidate remains governed by its explicit blocker, owner and revisit trigger.
Candidate-level identities, notices, advisories, runtime evidence, and dispositions are updated without converting unknown facts to approve.

tasks.scope: Five low-fidelity wireframes, shared focus/accessibility/safety contract, 12 tracked actions, and M1/M2 verification ownership.
tasks.definition_of_done_scope: M0 planning artifact only under ADR-0017 owner waiver

required_evidence: Disposition hierarchy, terminology, consequences, unavailable capability language, and all 12 actions.
Confirm current direct connection, production/read-only context, result-limit language, and unknown-outcome behavior match product intent.
Confirm static review and owning M1/M2 executable gates remain separate.
Review information hierarchy, native control intent, focus/default behavior, pane collapse, resizing, and localization reflow.
Confirm the artifact remains low fidelity, original, and not a pixel copy of another product.
Assign any unresolved visual/interaction decision an owner and executable revisit trigger.
Review forward/reverse focus, modal entry/return, errors, announcements, keyboard parity, logical grid/editor semantics, and manual VoiceOver plan.
Review Light/Dark, Increase Contrast, Differentiate Without Color, Reduce Motion, larger text, and non-color safety traits.
Confirm metadata/static review is not represented as executable Accessibility Inspector or VoiceOver evidence.
Review production/read-only target truth, destructive consequence, canonical preview digest binding, typed confirmation, and stale revalidation.
Review transaction/pending-edit close, unknown outcome, no auto-commit/retry, and non-dangerous defaults.
Confirm cancellation outcome is separate from execution outcome and connectionClosed never implies server stop or rollback.
Confirm SSH remains unavailable and direct test/connect paths omit SSH phases and host-key results.

Confirm database authentication method is separate from Keychain storage and review the provisional unstored-secret contract: sole ConnectionAttempt owner, non-renewable deadline at the earlier of action timeout or 60 seconds, all terminal/cancel/close revocation triggers, denied post-revocation access, and explicitly best-effort cleanup rather than guaranteed zeroization.

Review serialized cancellation ordering and race outcomes: requested/revoke/visible Cancelling/driver-forward order, success-before-cancel, stale late success and forced close, confirmed-only Cancelled, connectionClosed/typed-error/unsupported/deadline outcomes, idempotent repeated cancel and stale attempt-ID rejection.
Review same-path keyboard/pointer safeguards, no color-only warning, no insecure bypass, and no secret exposure in help/error/announcement text.

closure_rules: ADR-0017 waives all five review lanes as an M0 exit prerequisite without supplying a result.
All 12 actions retain their dispositions, owners and executable revisit triggers.
The owner waiver makes no runtime claim and cannot close an executable action.
Static planning closure does not authorize production UI; M1 and M2 require separate implementation requests and executable owning-milestone evidence.
